# Liberty Mutual

> > Liberty Mutual provides auto, home, renters, and life insurance with customizable coverage options, state-specific policies, and discounts including RightTrack savings programs.

Liberty Mutual Insurance has over 100 years of experience offering comprehensive insurance solutions across all 50 states. The company provides specialized coverage including NFIP flood insurance, accident assistance technology, and partnerships with programs like Enterprise rental car reimbursement and TruStage life insurance.

## Key Topics

- Liberty Mutual Insurance
- Auto Insurance Coverage
- Homeowners Insurance
- Renters Insurance
- Liability Coverage (Bodily Injury & Property Damage)
- State-Specific Insurance Requirements
- NFIP Flood Insurance (National Flood Insurance Program)
- Personal Injury Protection (PIP)
- Comprehensive and Collision Coverage
- RightTrack Discount Program
- Rental Car Reimbursement
- New Car Replacement
- Dwelling Coverage
- Accident Assistance Technology
